doc.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020

chapter: Sound Pieces and Los Angeles studios
title: Los Angeles personnel on his father's dates
summary: The studio players who were his father's regular group, including Buddy Collette, Bud Shank, Shelly Manne and Ray Brown.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I get such a charge out of still reading the personnel on music that came out of Los Angeles at that time. And you just — I mean I write arrangements too and I sometimes think oh my God if I could have that assemblage of people and have them play a chart of mine, that would be like so incredible.

Oh yeah. And this was normal stuff for him. I mean Buddy Collette, Bud Shank, Tom Scott, all those guys, Bobby Bryant on trumpet. I mean Garnett Brown on trombone, Shelly Manne played with them all the time. Ray Brown played with him a whole bunch of the time. So that was just kind of his normal set of people to play his music.
